title: ワイヤー買い物カート
description: 実際に隙間のあるワイヤーバスケット、可動式に見える後部ゲート、下段トレーと4つのキャスターを備えたカート。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 繰り返し部品は材質と構成単位ごとに統合済み。
descriptionEn: Shopping trolley with genuinely open tapered wire basket, rear nesting gate, lower wire tray, tubular chassis and four detailed swivel casters. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Repeated static details are grouped by material and assembly; the procedural source retains the editable construction.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.

provenance.tool: Blender 4.3.2; Meshcopia city generator 1.0; Meshcopia attribute-preserving static grouping 1.0
provenance.rights: Original geometry and material design created for Xenoah Meshcopia under the owner request for CC-BY-4.0 publication. No third-party meshes, scans, brands, logos or font files.

staticGrouping.positionOperation: translation baked to float32; validate roundoff bound
staticGrouping.normalUvMaterialOperation: source float values/material JSON preserved; no normal recomputation

provenance.changes: Repeated static details grouped by material and named assembly with original triangle-corner normals, UVs and material records preserved; no geometry simplification. Baseline GLB SHA-256: 00d5a62f67534f11225bde778eb87dfeafc5e940a9e65a8cf9237980ebc51bf6.
